result.title: Verified Proof Refactoring with Codex and Qwen
result.summary: We refactor existing Lean 4 proofs to reduce source length and checking cost while preserving theorem statements and compatibility across Lean versions. A locally served Qwen model uses the open-source Codex CLI to inspect source, retrieve declarations, and test proof replacements. The host keeps a replacement only if it improves the objective and Lean accepts it on every required version. A deterministic CPU pass then refines the verified proofs. On the 60 problems in Lean Refactor Arena, model search achieves a local mean combined score of 82.07, and cleanup raises it to 82.18. The final proofs pass all 127 required proof--version checks. Our system placed first in the open-source LLM track of Lean Refactor Arena at VeriCodeGen.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在保持定理陈述与跨 Lean 版本兼容的前提下重构 Lean 4 证明，以缩短源码并降低检查成本：本地 Qwen 经 Codex CLI 检索声明并尝试替换，宿主仅在目标改善且各版本 Lean 均通过时保留替换，最后用确定性 CPU 步骤精化。
